latest_release.name: v4.0.2
latest_release.body:
# BigBlueButton 4.0.2

BigBlueButton 4.0.2 adds Voice Isolation, an experimental audio-processing mode built on the BBBA filter, which now also needs less CPU; equation and diagram blocks in shared notes, with BlockNote updated to 0.56; and a `whiteboard.allowedAnnotationTypes` setting that limits the whiteboard shape types akka-apps accepts. The client now refuses a presentation over the size limit before uploading it, and fixes a race condition that could leave one of several users joining a new meeting at the same time stuck on the Oops screen, FreeSWITCH voice recordings shorter than the meeting, breakout rooms created through the API that outlived their parent meeting, chat message order across paginated queries, and Last-N audio pausing users who talk in favor of users who have only unmuted. Five client settings that had no effect are removed, and 84 slow or overlapping tests move from the pull-request gate to the nightly run. Below is a list of the pull requests in this iteration, grouped by component.

**Upgrade notes:**

* **Breaking change since 4.0.0:** phone dial-in callers on the LiveKit audio bridge, the default, skip the guest lobby, even when the guest policy is `ASK_MODERATOR`. They join the meeting as soon as they enter the conference PIN, and moderators cannot approve or deny them first. The FreeSWITCH audio bridge of 3.0 held them in the lobby. If you rely on the lobby for phone callers, use the FreeSWITCH bridge for those meetings: pass `audioBridge=bbb-webrtc-sfu` on `/create`, or set it server-wide in `/etc/bigbluebutton/bbb-web.properties`, and set up dial-in with the [FreeSWITCH steps](https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/4.0/administration/customize#add-a-phone-number-to-the-conference-bridge) as in 3.0. The [new features page](https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/4.0/new-features#media) now says so as well (#26409). Lobby support for dial-in on the LiveKit bridge is tracked in #26282.
* The HTML5 client now refuses a presentation larger than `public.presentation.mirroredFromBBBCore.uploadSizeMax` (30 MB by default) before uploading it. Until now only bbb-web checked the size, against `maxFileSizeUpload`, so raising that alone was enough. If you raised `maxFileSizeUpload` in `/etc/bigbluebutton/bbb-web.properties`, raise `uploadSizeMax` to the same value in `/etc/bigbluebutton/bbb-html5.yml`. Otherwise the client refuses files between the two limits, although bbb-web would accept them. See [Increase the file size for an uploaded presentation](https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/4.0/administration/customize#increase-the-file-size-for-an-uploaded-presentation). Details in #26383.
* Five client settings that had no effect were removed: `public.app.dynamicGuestPolicy`, `public.app.guestPolicyExtraAllowOptions`, `public.app.alwaysShowWaitingRoomUI`, `public.app.emojiRain.intervalEmojis` and `public.stats.help`. The upgrade does not remove them from `/etc/bigbluebutton/bbb-html5.yml`. bbb-apps-akka logs a leftover key there as an unknown key, and the value has no effect. With `clientSettingsOverrideStrictValidation=true` in `/etc/bigbluebutton/bbb-web.properties`, bbb-apps-akka refuses to start instead, and `/create` calls whose client settings override sets one of these keys are rejected. Remove them from the file, and from the overrides you send on `/create`, before upgrading. See [Validating client settings overrides](https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/4.0/administration/customize#validating-client-settings-overrides). Details in #26375, #26376 and #26379.

Link to installation command / instructions / schedule / planned features: https://docs.bigbluebutton.org/4.0/new-features

Big THANK YOU to all community members who helped for this release - both through sending pull requests and through reporting bugs or requesting enhancements! :confetti_ball:
